description: This Dart source file implements the HomeScreen16454 widget, which is a Flutter StatelessWidget representing the 'Home' screen of a mobile application. It contains UI elements such as cards, statistics, charts, and navigation components, all designed to closely match a Figma design within a pixel-accurate layout. The code includes various nested widgets, custom stylings, and navigation logic tied to user interactions.

classes.name: _VisaPart
classes.description: A helper widget to display Visa asset parts with specified height.

classes.name: _LegendRow
classes.description: A widget representing a row in the legend, with a color indicator and label text.

classes.name: _Bar
classes.description: A small vertical bar used as part of a bar chart visualization.

methods.description: Constructs a statistic card displaying a title and amount, with a faux chart stripe.
